title: How to Flip Houses with 100% Funding (No Money Needed!)
summary: House-flipping educator explains stacking hard money with second-position private money to fund deals with none of your own cash, then pitches his funding program.

assertions.quote: we're going to combine hard money and private money this is how I flip hundreds of houses

verdicts.note: Gap funding behind hard money is a standard flipper capital structure.

assertions.quote: if you're brand new to the business they're going to want you to put 20% down onto the deal plus plus other fees

verdicts.note: Typical hard money terms are 10-20% down, 2-4 points, and 10-14% interest.

assertions.quote: I call the $9,000 that we borrow from private money financing your financing

verdicts.note: Arithmetically possible but stacks expensive debt against a thin spread; delays or overruns erase the profit.

assertions.quote: it's more about access to Capital than it is cost of capital
I've never not gotten funding for deals if it was a good deal

verdicts.note: Hard money is widely available for deals at 65-70% of ARV, but lender appetite varies with the credit cycle.

assertions.quote: I'd rather give up half and be doing deals than and not do deals and sit at home

verdicts.note: A preference about trade-offs, not a testable claim.
